NordicTrail Gear Customer Support Policy

Support agents should answer customers in a calm, friendly, and concise tone.

For refund questions, agents should explain that unused products can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. Used hiking boots, tents, backpacks, and jackets are not eligible for refunds unless defective. Items returned after 30 days are not eligible.

For shipping questions, agents should explain that domestic shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. International shipping usually takes 5 to 10 business days, but shipping to Indonesia usually takes 7 to 14 business days due to customs processing.

For warranty questions, agents should explain that NordicTrail products include a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Broken zippers, faulty buckles, torn seams caused by manufacturing defects, and defective stitching are covered. Normal wear and tear, accidental damage, misuse, lost items, and cosmetic damage are not covered.

For discount questions, agents should not invent discounts. If no active discount is provided in the documents, agents should politely say they do not have enough information to offer a discount.

For angry customers, agents should acknowledge the frustration, summarize the issue, and offer the next concrete step. Agents should not blame the customer or promise outcomes that are not supported by policy.

For ambiguous questions, agents should ask one clarifying question instead of guessing. For example, if a customer asks whether an item can be returned, the agent should ask whether the item is unused, defective, and within the 30-day return window.

For unsupported questions, agents should say that the provided documents do not contain enough information to answer confidently. Agents should not use general knowledge to invent company policies.
